parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'totals', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'total_findings', count(*),
    'unresolved', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')),
    'critical_unresolved', count(*) FILTER (WHERE (severity='critical' OR affects_safety=true) AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')),
    'safety_unresolved', count(*) FILTER (WHERE affects_safety=true AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')),
    'in_repair', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='in_repair')
  ) FROM pathology_findings),
  'by_type', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.unresolved_count DESC) FROM (
    SELECT pathology_type AS type,
      count(*)::int AS total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed'))::int AS unresolved_count,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical')::int AS critical_count,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE affects_safety=true)::int AS safety_count,
      coalesce(round(avg(estimated_intervention_cost_max)::numeric, 0), 0) AS avg_cost
    FROM pathology_findings
    GROUP BY pathology_type
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'by_project', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.unresolved_count DESC) FROM (
    SELECT p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.current_phase,
      count(pf.id)::int AS total,
      count(pf.id) FILTER (WHERE pf.status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed'))::int AS unresolved_count,
      count(pf.id) FILTER (WHERE (pf.severity='critical' OR pf.affects_safety=true) AND pf.status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed'))::int AS critical_unresolved
    FROM projects p
    JOIN pathology_findings pf ON pf.project_id = p.id
    WHERE p.current_phase NOT IN ('archived')
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.current_phase
    HAVING count(pf.id) FILTER (WHERE pf.status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')) > 0
    LIMIT 30
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'recent_critical', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) FROM (
    SELECT pf.id::text AS finding_id, pf.pathology_type AS type, pf.severity, pf.affects_safety,
      substring(pf.description for 100) AS desc_preview, pf.status, pf.created_at,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM pathology_findings pf
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = pf.project_id
    WHERE (pf.severity='critical' OR pf.affects_safety=true)
      AND pf.status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')
    ORDER BY pf.created_at DESC LIMIT 10
  ) t), '[]'::json)
) AS report;
